name: Create a Jira Issue
description: Creates a Jira Cloud issue with proper Atlassian Document Format (ADF) for the description field. Handles project/issue-type lookup by key, ADF encoding, labels, priority, and optional subtask creation.

jiraCloudId.description: Jira Cloud site ID (UUID). Get it via the Get Sites action.

issueTypeId.description: Issue type ID (e.g., '10001' for Task). Use Get Create Issue Metadata to find valid IDs.

description.description: Plain text description. Auto-converted to Atlassian Document Format (ADF).

labels.description: Array of label strings to apply

parentKey.description: Parent issue key for subtask creation (e.g., 'PROJ-123')

steps.name: Build issue creation payload with ADF description
Create the issue via Jira API
